title: Eventual comparison with a finite-presentation module model
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit cocone $(C,\iota)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and fix $i\in I$. Let $A,B$ be finitely presented $F(i)$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], $f:A\to B$ an $F(i)$-algebra map, and $M$ a finitely presented $B$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Set $X=C\otimes_{F(i)}A$ and $Y=C\otimes_{F(i)}B$. Let $P,Q$ be commutative rings with a map $P\to Q$, and $L$ a $Q$-module, with $P$ finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$, $Q$ finitely presented over $P$, and $L$ finitely presented over $Q$. Suppose given $P\to X$, a ring isomorphism $e:X\otimes_P Q\simeq Y$ whose restriction to $X$ is the tensor extension of $f$, and a $Y$-linear isomorphism $Y\otimes_Q L\simeq Y\otimes_B M$, where the $Q$-action on $Y$ is $q\mapsto e(1\otimes q)$ and its $B$-action is its right tensor inclusion. Then there is $j_0\geq i$ such that for every $j\geq j_0$, with $A_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i)}A$ using the transition map $F(i)\to F(j)$, there is a $P$-algebra structure on $A_j$ and an $A_j$-linear isomorphism $A_j\otimes_P L\simeq A_j\otimes_A M$. Here $L$ is restricted from $Q$ to $P$ and $M$ is restricted from $B$ to $A$. No module in the hypotheses is required to be flat.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-tensor-model-algebra-descent to obtain a tail k, compatible ring maps q_j:Q→B_j, and the pushout square P→A_j, Q→B_j at every stage of the tail. This is precisely the algebra part of the original proof, with no module hypothesis involved.

Apply lem-pc-compatible-module-model-descent with q_C=e composed with the right inclusion and the given eM. The compatibility clauses obtained in the first step are exactly its hypotheses. Obtain j₀≥k and B_j-linear equivalences B_j tensor_Q L≃B_j tensor_B M for all j≥j₀.

For each j≥j₀ let D=A_j and E=B_j. The first pushout gives E tensor_Q L≃D tensor_P L by Mathlib Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange. The canonical tensor pushouts F(i)→A and F(i)→B, after extension to F(j), compose to the pushout A→D, B→E by Mathlib Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff; its cancellation gives E tensor_B M≃D tensor_A M. Restrict the middle module equivalence to D and compose the inverse of the first cancellation with it and the second cancellation. This constructs the required D-linear equivalence. The P and A module structures on L and M are precisely Module.compHom, with towers from IsScalarTower.of_compHom. The AddCommGroup structures needed by cancellation are the canonical structures Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup for modules over rings. Proof irrelevance identifies the transition algebra structures induced by the two proofs of i≤j.

proof_origin.place: Tag 02JO (3), final paragraph, split into algebra and compatible-module descent; combination formalized by P4 using Mathlib pushout composition and cancellation.

theorem exists_eventually_tensor_model_equiv
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    {i : I} {A B M : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) A] [Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) A]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (F.obj i : Type v) B]
    [Module B M] [Module.FinitePresentation B M] (f : A →ₐ[F.obj i] B)
    (P Q L : Type x) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [AddCommMonoid L] [Module Q L]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    [Module.FinitePresentation Q L]
    (aP : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A))
    (e : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B)
    (he : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (c.pt : Type v) (c.pt : Type v))
          f).toRingHom)
    (eM : letI : Algebra (F.obj i : Type v) (c.pt : Type v) := (c.ι.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      letI : Algebra Q ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) :=
        (e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra B ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Nonempty (((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) ⊗[Q] L ≃ₗ[
        (c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B] ((c.pt : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] B) ⊗[B] M)) :
    letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M f.toRingHom
    letI : Module P L := Module.compHom L (algebraMap P Q)
    ∃ j₀ : I, i ≤ j₀ ∧ ∀ (j : I) (h₀ : i ≤ j₀) (h₁ : j₀ ≤ j),
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE (h₀.trans h₁))).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra A ((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      ∃ aPj : Algebra P ((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A),
        letI := aPj
        Nonempty (((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[P] L ≃ₗ[
          (F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A] ((F.obj j : Type v) ⊗[F.obj i] A) ⊗[A] M)
